goal: Growth-biased hybrid block: rebuild strength, gain size, maintain aerobic fitness, and reintroduce controlled explosiveness. Size remains primary; secondary running targets: sub-19:00 5K on 2026-08-22; 1:35 half marathon on 2026-11-22.

days.title: Easy Aerobic
description: Easy run RPE 3-4: 5 km at conversational effort.
Mobility: 8-10 min for hips, calves, ankles, and thoracic rotation.
Fueling: use a small carbohydrate snack if training early or after poor sleep.

days.title: Longer Aerobic
description: Easy run RPE 3-4: 8 km conversational; keep the finish controlled.
Recovery: protein, carbohydrates, fluids, and gentle mobility after the run.

days.title: Upper Strength
description: Warm-up: 5-8 min easy cardio, joint preparation, and ramp sets for the first movement.
Bench press: 3 working sets at RPE 8.
Pull-ups: 3 working sets at RPE 8.
Overhead press or Arnold press: 3 working sets at RPE 8.
Chest-supported row: 3 working sets at RPE 8.
Lateral raises: 3 working sets at RPE 8.
Pallof press: 3 working sets at RPE 7.
Progression: double progression; add load only after clean top-range reps at RPE 8 or lower, about 2 RIR.

days.title: Lower Strength
description: Warm-up: 5-8 min easy cardio, joint preparation, and ramp sets for the first movement.
Hack squat or goblet squat: 3 working sets at RPE 8.
Romanian deadlift: 3 working sets at RPE 8.
Seated or lying hamstring curl: 3 working sets at RPE 8.
Seated calf raise: 3 working sets at RPE 7.
Tibialis raises: 4 working sets at RPE 7.
Side plank: 2 working sets at RPE 7.
Activation: light good mornings: 2 x 12-15 at RPE 5-6 using no more than 50% of normal working load; stop if symptoms rise or the next morning is worse.
Progression: double progression; add load only after clean top-range reps at RPE 8 or lower, about 2 RIR.

days.title: Recovery
description: Recovery: no working resistance sets, running, sprinting, or plyometrics.
Optional: easy walking and gentle mobility at RPE 2-3 if comfortable.

exercise_targets.name: Rear delt fly or reverse pec-deck

days.title: Speed / Power
description: Warm-up jog: 10 min easy plus skips, ankling, and 3 relaxed strides.
Plyometrics: pogos 3 x 20 sec and low broad jumps 3 x 3 at crisp RPE 6-7.
Hill sprint technique: 4-6 x 8-12 sec at sprint RPE 7-8 with full walk-back recovery.
Stop if mechanics soften or symptoms are worse the next morning.

description: Recovery: no working resistance sets, running, sprinting, or plyometrics.
